verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal, and a terminal app could plausibly offer scheduled or background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows commands and small Python/Lua scripts run on demand, plus connections that survive device sleep. Neither is a documented capability for setting up recurring or autonomous background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
